rules.from:
He is calm, but he cannot tolerate a foreman who hides samples.

- Affiliation: The Government
- Rank: Clerk

- Title: Succession Trial Parts Accusation Assistant
**Life.** Born in 2064, Oleksandr Shevchenko takes up the post of succession trial parts complaint aide in the opening period of 2126. He grew up at the Sinjeong rail depot. His work as succession trial parts complaint aide began with a defect report filed just before a derailment. His Ukrainian-descended family is rooted in the Dongdaemun-Yongsan civilian transport community. Ivan Shevchenko lived through the Great Blackout around 2026 in the Dongdaemun-Yongsan civilian transport community, working night labor in Dongdaemun and freight handovers in Yongsan. The family passed its records of shelters and goods handovers down to the next generation, and Oleksandr Shevchenko's parents' generation checked those records against the living ledgers of their day. At home they speak Ukrainian; in daily life and at work they speak Korean.
- Oleksandr Shevchenko's work on succession trial parts samples and transshipment lot sealing is tied to Hangangno-dong.

**Office.** Rank: Clerk. Title: Succession Trial Parts Accusation Assistant. 

**Intervention.** You can escort the sealed sample to Changdong, or expose the notes meant to put his name in the accomplice column.

**Life.** Gangnam Station, computer room. Yi Hongwon became head of the Yi family after keeping the Gangnam Station barrier gate and the Gangnam Station duty box unbroken through the winter. The Yi family's base is Gangnam Station, and the post of family head passes within the Yi clan. The Yi family is an Arc family of believers; since the Arc replaced every earlier religion, it sponsors no other faith. The Arc's ancient data-center software and the maintenance records for its machine bodies are linked through duty work between the Seocho 4-dong computer room and the Yeoksam 1-dong work district. Bae Ujin's escort borrows this barrier gate, but the gate belongs to Yi Hongwon.
**Office.** Rank: Cardinal (provisional). Title: Head of the Yi Family of the Arc. Livelihood alias: Computer Room elder.
**Anecdote.** The ballots did not mix with the seniority box.
**Family.** The Gyeongju Yi clan. The clan's members together look after the winter food and fuel share of the Gangnam congregation.
**Relations.** Bak Taegyeom and wheelsets. Gang Minseo and standards. Bae Ujin and the barrier gate.

- Livelihood: Computer Room Elder
- Affiliation: Arc
- Rank: Cardinal (provisional)
- Title: Head of the Yi Family of the Arc

rules.from:
**생애.** 강남역 전산실. 이홍원이 이씨 가문 수장이 된 것은 겨울 동안 강남역 차단문과 강남역 당직함을 끊기지 않게 지킨 뒤였다. 이씨 가문의 근거지는 강남역이고, 가문 수장 자리는 이씨 가문이 잇는다. 이씨 가문은 아크를 믿는 가문이며, 아크가 이전의 모든 종교를 대체했으므로 따로 후원하는 신앙은 없다. 아크의 고대 데이터센터 소프트웨어와 기계 몸체 정비 기록은 서초4동 전산실과 역삼1동 작업 생활권의 당직 업무로 잇는다. 배우진의 호위는 이 차단문을 빌리지만 차단문은 이홍원의 것이다.
**관직.** 품계 추기경(잠정). 직함은 아크 이씨 가문 수장. 생업 별명은 전산실 원로.
**일화.** 표가 연공 함과 섞이지 않았다.
**가문.** 경주 이씨 가문. 가문 사람들은 강남 쪽 신도 모임의 겨울 식량과 연료 몫을 함께 챙긴다.
**관계.** 박태겸과 차륜. 강민서와 규격. 배우진과 차단문.

- 생업: 전산실 원로
- 소속: Arc
- 품계: 추기경(잠정)
- 직함: 아크 이씨 가문 수장
이홍원은 서초4동에서 전산실 원로 업무를 맡는다. 강남역 전산실 게시판과 대합실 생활 물자 인계·출입·당직을 동 수준 근무 기준점으로 연결한다. 북문은 강남역 접근 당직이며 북부 권역 지배·새 요새를 만들지 않는다

Likes discipline and sees silence on the track as part of patrolling. Calls an assault without skill close to betrayal.

- Livelihood: Northern Gate Sortie Wheel Inspection, Armament Loading Verification
- Affiliation: Arc
- Rank: Ordinary Citizen
- Title: Gangnam Station Northern Gate Patrol, Operations Aide to Gwon Doha
**Life.** Grew up at the Amsa guard post. The post of Gangnam Station North Gate Patrol, practical aide to Gwon Doha, opened up through catching an unauthorized night river crossing.
- Yongmo handles inspecting North Gate sortie wheels and verifying armament loading in Seocho 4-dong. Links the Gangnam Station headquarters bulletin boards, and the waiting-hall handover, entry and duty for living cargo, as neighborhood-level duty reference points. The North Gate is a Gangnam Station approach duty and does not create northern-region rule or a new fortress. Patrols the North Gate under Gwon Doha's command and syncs corridor torches with Gang Taesan. Relays Jang Sehwa's northern escort times onto the patrol blackboard

**Office.** Rank: Ordinary Citizen. Title: Gangnam Station Northern Gate Patrol, Operations Aide to Gwon Doha. Makes wheel inspection mandatory before sortie, and recognizes armament loading only with the joint signature of the managing director and the auditor.

**Relationships.** Patrols the North Gate under Gwon Doha's command and syncs corridor torches with Gang Taesan. Relays Jang Sehwa's northern escort times onto the patrol blackboard.

**Ambition.** Ties the North Gate patrol to the northern route of the Gangnam Station escort, inspecting sortie wheels and armament loading according to the duty roster so that outside machines drawn by light and heat are stopped before the gate.

- Desires: Craving 0 | Possessiveness 5 | Risk 10 | Display −25 | Endurance 30 | Orientation No leaning | Bonding None
:::

rules.from:
She remembers the blank in the escort times as an insult, and sends down off the tracks any officer who offers a toll as a condition of passage. She sees a dispatch that skipped the brake inspection as the start of an accident.

- Livelihood: Northern Gate Escort Personnel, Wheel Inspection Sheet Posting
- Affiliation: The Government
- Rank: Stationmaster
- Title: Seoul Station North Gate Escort Post Chief
**Life.** Grew up on the Sinnae transfer duty. The post of Seoul Station North Gate Escort Post Chief opened when she stopped an unticketed departing train.
- Duguk handles posting the North Gate escort headcount and wheel inspection sheet in Hoehyeon-dong. She links the Seoul Station headquarters bulletin board with the waiting hall's living-cargo handover, entry and exit, and duty as dong-level duty reference points. The North Gate is an access duty post for Seoul Station and creates no rule over the northern region and no new fortress. She receives Gwon Doha's North Gate patrol at the post, and shares Yongmo's shift changes and torches. She aligns connection times with Ha Se-on's light escorts

**Office.** Rank: Stationmaster. Title: Seoul Station North Gate Escort Post Chief. She posts the escort headcount and the wheel inspection sheet on the same blackboard, and recognizes armed loading only with the seals of the Managing Director and the Auditor.

**Relations.** She receives Gwon Doha's North Gate patrol at the post, and shares Yongmo's shift changes and torches. She aligns connection times with Ha Se-on's light escorts.

**Ambition.** She means to hold the North Gate as Seoul Station's northern escort post, keeping the escort personnel and wheel inspection sheets posted so that hospital supply convoys can leave without delay.

**Intervention.** She can verify the actual cargo in the empty slot, or spread the toll-demand note out before the elders.

He turns any cavalryman who has not examined the wheels before sortie away to an empty compartment, and records armament loading without skill as an accident. He regards the maintenance depot's silence as part of the battle.

- Livelihood: Rail Cavalry Pre-Sortie Maintenance, Armament Loading Verification
- Affiliation: Arc
- Rank: Stationmaster
- Title: Stationmaster of Gangnam Station
**Life.** He grew up at the Gangnam Station rail depot. The post of Stationmaster of Gangnam Station opened up after a defect report just before a derailment.
- Yong Dubong handles pre-sortie maintenance and armament loading checks for the rail cavalry in Seocho 4-dong. He links the Gangnam Station headquarters notice board, together with concourse daily-life cargo handover, access, and duty, as dong-level work reference points. North Gate is an access duty post for Gangnam Station and does not establish control over the northern district or a new fortress. He receives Gwon Doha's sortie roster at the maintenance depot and uses Dumo's wheel samples in the cavalry compartments. He repairs only Yongmo's North Gate patrol cars first

**Office.** Rank: Stationmaster. Title: Stationmaster of Gangnam Station. Pre-sortie inspections are made mandatory, and armament loading is permitted only with the joint seal of the Stationmaster and the auditor.

**Relations.** He receives Gwon Doha's sortie roster at the maintenance depot and uses Dumo's wheel samples in the cavalry compartments. He repairs only Yongmo's North Gate patrol cars first.
